messages:
anya: Quick thread 4F0 SilverPike case study planning. Interview locked for Mon May 12 9:00am PT. Deliverables: 800-1000 word launch post, 30s testimonial clip, social cutdowns, and a follow-up joint webinar (TBD). Need quote + logo license + metric permission by Fri May 9 EOD.

kyle: I'll handle recording + editors. Can we get an explicit embargo date? SilverPike hinted at a partner coann that week. If embargo needed we should know now so clips don't leak.

rachel: PR note: I'll draft two headline options and a short FAQ for the customer to approve. Also prepping a lead routing sheet so inbound demo requests from the launch route to AE team A. Any special lead tags we want?

theo: Suggest tag: "case_silverpike_launch" and "webinar_interest". Ops can set up a zap to push leads to SFDC camp. I'll ping ops after we confirm the embargo.

anya: Draft quote proposal (please edit before I send):
```
"Redwood's runtime let us build live insights into our product faster than we thought possible. We launched without touching our inference stack."  Mira S., CTO, SilverPike
```
Thoughts on tightening? Avoid mention of specific costs.

kyle: Could tighten to one sentence and swap the last clause to "without adding infra work." Maybe: "Redwood's runtime let us build live insights quickly, without adding infra work."

rachel: PR preference: ask them to confirm any measurable impact if they want it in headline (e.g., "decreased response time by X"). If they provide, legal needs written permission.

legal-bot: Legal reminder: must have an explicit written line for any metrics and logo use. If customer supplies numbers, capture exact wording and date; add footer: "Approved for public release by SilverPike, [date]". Route redlines to legal@redwood.example.

theo: On webinar routing  if we do a co-hosted webinar, we'll need a joint speaker line-up and a co-promo plan. Can someone propose 3 dates to SilverPike during the interview?

anya: Quick checklist before the interview:
- Send quote + logo request to Mira (K: today)
- Legal to confirm copy format if metrics included (Legal-bot/Mira)
- Kyle record + capture 16:9 and headshot frames
- Rachel draft launch + lead routing doc
- Theo ops tags + zap prep

kyle: Recording checklist: local backup + cloud recording, record separate audio track, timestamp chapters for clips. Editors will want 30s, 60s, 2m cuts.

rachel: Lead routing: I'll tag SDR queue B and include the "case_silverpike_launch" tag. Theo, please confirm zap can also set "lead_source=webinar" if someone signs up from the promo.

theo: Confirmed, zap can set lead_source to "webinar" and add tag when form param "interest=webinar" is present. Will need form mapping.

anya: I'll send the quote + assets request now. Pasting draft message: > Hi Mira  thanks again. Can you confirm the quote below and confirm you can share the SilverPike logo (SVG)? If you have a publishable metric, please include exact wording and a line "Approved for public release by SilverPike, [date]" so legal can record it. Also let us know if we should embargo until a partner announcement.

kyle: Send it. Also ask if they want a 15s social teaser cut.

rachel: Sent. I'll open the Asana card after we get reply and assign reviewers.

(10m later)

rachel: Mira replied in DM: "Quote approved as-is, attaching SVG and ok to publish. We're coordinating with PartnerX; please embargo publish until May 18. Also we can share a 12% reduction in median response time — attaching permission line: 'Approved for public release by SilverPike, May 15 2026.'" Attaching link to SVG in drive.

legal-bot: Received permission line. Legal: register approval record and confirm no redlines. Routing to legal-team for final sign-off.

theo: Great  I'll set embargo in the CMS for May 18 and add tags for lead routing. Ops: I'll message you the zap config.

kyle: Recording still on May 12. Editors, heads-up the 12% stat is cleared; include it in the metrics block. We'll time-stamp where Mira mentions it so PR can pull direct quote.

rachel: I'll include the 12% stat in the PR FAQ and use outcome-first headline. Drafting now.

anya: Final action list: Kyle -> record + capture frames; Rachel -> draft post + lead routing doc; Theo -> ops zap + embargo scheduling; Legal-bot -> log approval and confirm final copy after edit. I'll loop back with final launch calendar.

kyle: On it. Will upload raw and clips to /shared/marketing/silverpike after call.

(End thread 4DD assets and permissions saved in drive; embargo set for May 18)
